response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years of experience across web, backend, and some embedded/C++ work, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, JavaScript, DLang) rather than modern C++. His only substantial C++ exposure was a brief 6-month role in 2014-2015 and an early bachelor's thesis project, with no recent hands-on C++/STL architecture work, no IEC 62443/SDL security experience, no MQTT/REST IoT platform work, and no industrial automation background — all core requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience (15+ years) with strong ownership and mentoring track record
Demonstrated experience with networked, high-performance, low-latency systems (Dlang, async I/O, microservices at Dunnhumby)
Strong communication and knowledge-sharing skills (talks, workshops, open-source projects) aligning with documentation/mentoring needs
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (~6 months, over 10 years ago) — not the deep, current C++/STL/OOP architecture expertise required
No evidence of IEC 62443, Secure Development Lifecycle, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No MQTT, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850/104, DNP3), or industrial automation/IoT platform background

key_factors.factor: Strong general seniority, architecture, and system design experience
